back: The only place where heads interact within the layer: $\text{out}=\sum_i Z^{(i)}W_O^{(i)}$ with row blocks of $W_O$.

front: Why a causal mask lets us train in parallel
back: One forward pass gives $T$ next-token predictions, each seeing only its own prefix; no step needs the previous output.
Fewer key/value heads than query heads (1 for MQA, $G$ groups for GQA): same query capacity, smaller key/value cache when generating.
